name: MAI-Code-1-Flash
short: Microsoft's Jun 2026 Copilot-native agentic coding model (5B active, 256K): SWE-Bench Pro 51.2% vs Haiku 4.5's 35.2% and up to 60% fewer tokens at $0.75/$4.50.
pricingNote: $0.75/$4.50 per 1M in/out (GitHub Copilot / models.dev); no Microsoft price card published
standout: A 5B-active model that beat Haiku 4.5 by 16 points on SWE-Bench Pro inside real Copilot, and used 60% fewer tokens.
tradeoff: Three of the four harness evals exist only as chart images, the successor is cheaper and stronger, and OpenRouter never listed it despite Microsoft's announcement.
pricingTiers: GitHub Copilot $0.75/M in, $4.50/M out (no published cache rate)
